execution_requirements.replay_command: acquire the NIST-JARVIS OPTIMADE endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: hidden JARVIS target property appears in visible descriptors; official JARVIS snapshot hash is missing or changes; composition-family median comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty; fewer than 20 material/property targets are scored

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict each hidden property using the visible-row median for the same element-count family; fall back to global visible median.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

replay.replay_command: acquire the NIST-JARVIS OPTIMADE endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check
replay_commands: acquire the NIST-JARVIS OPTIMADE endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual per material/property plus aggregate MAE over hidden targets
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: descriptor model MAE plus bootstrap upper margin must be lower than the composition-family median comparator

residuals.material_margin_rule: descriptor model MAE plus bootstrap upper margin must be lower than the composition-family median comparator

source.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.source_name: NIST-JARVIS JARVIS-DFT OPTIMADE structures and materials-property records

target_variable.name: elastic_stiffness_and_bandgap_material_property
target_variable.unit: GPa for moduli; eV for bandgap

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual per material/property plus aggregate MAE over hidden targets
uncertainty_requirement.rule: visible-row bootstrap interval declared before hidden property fields are unsealed

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
